summary: Round aluminum baseplate, 144 mm diameter and 6 mm thick. It has a flat top and bottom face and a pattern of through holes. Some holes are counterbored, and five hub-pattern clusters (one central, four outer) each have a large central opening with keyhole-style slots. The plate can be fastened to a floor or tabletop, or used as a rotating platform on a hub.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat top face with counterbored holes for mounting assemblies. Counterbores let M4 hardware sit below the surface.
Flat bottom face that rests on a floor or tabletop. Rubber feet can be attached here.

notes: The 144 mm diameter and 6 mm thickness come from the supplied specs, which are marked unverified. The images show no printed hole dimensions. Only the central large opening is listed, and its 14 mm diameter is a rough visual estimate. The remaining holes are not listed because their sizes and positions could not be read reliably. They include the four outer hub-pattern clusters, the many small M4-class holes, and the counterbored holes. The plate is centered at the origin, with the z-axis normal to its faces.
